role: Java Full Stack Developer — L1 (Internal Project Round)

questions.question: Introduce yourself and explain your project architecture, responsibilities, and the Java Full Stack technologies you have worked with.
As of 2026, what is the latest stable version of Spring Boot? What are its key improvements, and which Java versions does it support?
Explain the Strategy design pattern in Java. Where have you implemented it in a real project?
What are behavioral design patterns? Name a few and explain a practical use case.
What is a marker interface in Java? Why is it used, and how would you create a custom marker interface?
What is a DTO (Data Transfer Object), and why is it important in enterprise applications?
Explain the difference between a DTO and a POJO with practical examples.
What is an anonymous class in Java? When would you use it instead of a named class?
What is an immutable class? Why is immutability important in Java applications?
Explain how to create an immutable class in Java using a simple Notepad example, and discuss best practices.
